name: doodle-dash-tv-studio
description: Doodle Dash Production — Blender-first, EEVEE-first children’s animation studio

scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/domain typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/universe typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/characters typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/story typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/direction typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/preproduction typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/production typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/rendering typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/audio typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/providers typecheck && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/web typecheck
scripts.rig:audit: blender -b -noaudio --python scripts/assets/audit_rig.py -- --blend production-library/characters/pip_production.blend --role pip --out artifacts/rig-audit/pip_after.json && blender -b -noaudio --python scripts/assets/audit_rig.py -- --blend production-library/characters/goat_production.blend --role goat --out artifacts/rig-audit/goat_after.json
scripts.rig:repair: blender -b -noaudio --python scripts/assets/repair_rigs.py -- --blend production-library/characters/pip_production.blend --role pip --report artifacts/rig-audit/pip_repair.json && blender -b -noaudio --python scripts/assets/repair_rigs.py -- --blend production-library/characters/goat_production.blend --role goat --report artifacts/rig-audit/goat_repair.json
scripts.validate:scenery-intake: pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/web exec vitest run src/lib/scenery-intake.test.ts && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/web exec tsx ../../scripts/preproduction/validate-scenery-intake.ts
scripts.validate:scenery-intake-preview: pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/web exec vitest run src/lib/scenery-intake-preview.test.ts && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/web exec tsx ../../scripts/preproduction/validate-scenery-intake-preview.ts
scripts.validate:scenery-pipeline-hardening: pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/web exec vitest run src/lib/scenery-pipeline-hardening.test.ts && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/web exec tsx ../../scripts/preproduction/validate-scenery-pipeline-hardening.ts
scripts.validate:runpod-guarded: node --test scripts/cloud/tivvlejoy-guarded-render.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/web exec vitest run src/lib/tivvlejoy-guarded-render.test.ts
scripts.validate:runpod-blender-foundation: node --test scripts/cloud/tivvlejoy-remote-blender-foundation.test.mjs && node scripts/cloud/tivvlejoy-remote-blender-foundation.mjs dry-run && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/web exec vitest run src/lib/tivvlejoy-remote-blender-foundation.test.ts
scripts.validate:runpod-pod-payload: node --test scripts/cloud/tivvlejoy-guarded-pod-payload.test.mjs && node scripts/cloud/tivvlejoy-guarded-pod-payload.mjs pod-payload-dry-run && pnpm --filter @doodle-dash/web exec vitest run src/lib/tivvlejoy-guarded-pod-payload.test.ts
